name: Nivel Base de Ruido de Audio
algorithm: Audio Noise Floor — Sensor/Physical Model Analyzer
mechanism:
This method analyzes the audio noise floor characteristics for deepfake detection following Chen et al. (2020):

1. **Ruido Floor Estimación**: The background noise level is estimated across frequency bands using minimum statistics or MMSE-based methods. Real audio recordings contain characteristic noise profiles shaped by microphone electronics, room acoustics, and environmental sounds with specific spectral coloring.

2. **Espectral Ruido Perfil Análisis**: The noise floor spectrum is compared against expected characteristics for genuine recordings. Real microphones produce noise with predictable spectral shape (often pink/brownian). AI-generated audio typically produces either unnaturally clean signals (absence of environmental noise) or artificially added noise with incorrect spectral characteristics.

3. **Temporal Ruido Consistencia**: The noise floor is tracked across the recording duration. In authentic recordings, ambient noise varies naturally with room dynamics but maintains consistent spectral character. Deepfake audio may show noise floor discontinuities at splice points or unnatural noise stationarity across the entire clip.

4. **Ruido - Señal Correlación Análisis**: In real recordings, background noise acoustically interacts with the speech signal via room reverberation. The method checks whether noise-signal correlations follow physical room acoustic models. Synthesized speech overlaid on separately generated or copied noise lacks these natural cross-correlations.

5. **Quantization Ruido Evaluación**: The quantization noise pattern is examined for codec consistency. Re-encoded deepfake audio shows double-quantization artifacts in the noise floor — subtle but detectable statistical irregularities in the least significant bits that differ from single-pass recording chains.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: sensor
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante audio noise floor analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Chen, T. et al. (2020). Generalization of Audio Deepfake Detection. Odyssey.
Chugh, K. et al. (2020). Not Made for Each Other — Audio-Visual Dissonance-based Deepfake Detection. ACM MM.
